subject: Security due diligence kickoff — deployment topology & questionnaire
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@medquant.com>, Alex Torres <alex.torres@medquant.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Security due diligence kickoff — deployment topology & questionnaire

Thanks again for the time today — appreciate the clear requirements. Quick recap and next steps from our side so everyone's aligned: 

Summary of key asks from your team:
- SOC 2 status and expected timeline for Type II report (you mentioned an audit window in Q3)
- GDPR / HIPAA scope: which datasets need encryption-at-rest + in-transit, and whether we need BAA
- Vendor security questionnaire (you asked for the questionnaire to start the intake)
- Private deployment constraints: VPC peering vs. VPN, air-gapped option feasibility, network diagram showing permitted egress

Immediate actions (Redwood):
1) Sharing our vendor security questionnaire (attached) to capture architecture, controls, and evidence requirements. Please complete or point to an existing questionnaire format you prefer.
2) Attach our short deployment options PDF — outlines VPC, dedicated private control plane, and an on-prem air-gapped profile. If you could flag which topology you want scoped (VPC peering vs. fully air-gapped), we'll draw a tailored diagram.
3) Kimberly will be the primary intake owner for the questionnaire and evidence collection (cc'd). Grace will own the compliance alignment and escalation path.

Questions for you to help us scope the diagram and evidence set:
- Do you require zero egress (no internet) for inference nodes, or is controlled egress to specific Redwood endpoints acceptable?
- Approximate model size / memory footprint and expected QPS for peak workloads (we can recommend batching/quantization if air-gapped imposes constraints)
- Any specific data residency regions (EU/US) or customer restrictions we should be aware of now?

Next meeting: propose Tue May 26 10:00 AM PT for a 30-min follow-up to finalize questionnaire scope and confirm the SA who will draft the topology. Does that work?

Attachments referenced:
- redwood-vendor-security-questionnaire.pdf (fillable)
- redwood-deployment-options.pdf (overview diagrams)

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to intake.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | (415) 555-0117

From: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@medquant.com>

Cc: it_ops@medquant.com
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security due diligence kickoff — deployment topology & questionnaire

Thanks Sean — good summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) SOC 2: We are currently SOC 2 Type I in place; Type II audit window is planned for early Q4 2026. That means we will need control evidence for the last 6 months; we can share the SOC 2 roadmap but cannot provide a Type II report yet.

2) HIPAA/GDPR: HIPAA applies for a subset of our dataset. We will need a BAA and controls around PHI handling. For GDPR, most of our PHI-equivalent data remains in the US for now, but one of our EU customers requires EU residency — we may ask for a regional deployment.

3) Network: Our preferred model is VPC peering with strict egress rules; fully air-gapped is acceptable for a limited pilot but would require on-site install and offline packaging. Can you confirm whether your air-gapped option supports offline model updates (we may need weekly model pushes)?

4) Schedule: Tue May 26 10:00 AM PT works for a quick sync. I'll loop in our infra lead (it_ops@medquant.com) to the call.

I've attached the contact vCard for our IT security lead.

Thanks,
Priya Reddy
Director of Product & Security Programs
MedQuant Health

1) Kimberly: take ownership of the questionnaire intake. Action: convert redwood-vendor-security-questionnaire.pdf into a shared Google form and pre-fill answers for common controls (SOC 2 controls, encryption at rest/in transit, KMS options). Target: draft form by EOD Tue May 26.

2) Kimberly: prepare a minimal compliance packet we can share pre-call — include our SOC 2 Type II timeline statement, encryption architecture summary, and a checklist for BAA/PHI handling. We should be explicit about what evidence we can provide now vs. what will be available post-Type II.

3) Sean: confirm the SA to draft the VPC peering diagram and an air-gapped appendix for the pilot. Recommend Marcus Lin (solutions architect) if available; if not, Kimberly can request an on-call SA.

4) Internal escalation path: If MedQuant requires zero egress and weekly model pushes, escalate to Engineering for an implementation feasibility review — include estimated timelines/costs.

I'll join the Tue follow-up.
